prompt: Someone asks where you're from. Give the maximally American answer, including at least one thing about your hometown's high school football team.
response: I'm from Odessa, Texas—Friday Night Lights country, baby. Permian High School Panthers, state champions '89, and I will fight you if you say Mojo isn't the greatest high school football program to ever grace God's green earth. We played our first game in diapers, probably. My dad still has the bumper sticker.
